title: FieldDef
description: What a procedure DECLARES a step must produce. The filled version is Field.

key.description: Stable within the step. e.g. pad_torque.

kind.description: The discriminator. Decides which value slot on Field is meaningful.

prompt.description: What to do. Shown as the instruction.

source.description: instrument is the only source that can yield the measured class.

required_at_strictness.description: 0 log, 1 standard, 2 assured, 3 regulated; 4 means never required. The field is required at or above this. Strictness tops out at 3, so 4 is unreachable by construction rather than by a flag some reader might forget to check — the ONE filter at web/src/server/adjudicate/run.ts already excludes it. An optional field is still captured and still judged; it simply cannot hold the step.

choices.description: Only meaningful when kind is choice.

acceptance_rule.description: Decides the provenance class. within/matches/per_spec resolve without a model.

acceptance_target.description: For matches/consistent_with/signed_by: what it resolves against.

acceptance_description.description: For must_show: what the media has to show.

guidance.description: What good looks like, in plain language. Shown to the human BEFORE the capture — the same rule the Inspector applies after it.
